# Evaluator provenance
This module implements the local V17/PUMA behavior required by Exploration 8. Historical Exploration-7 source hashes are recorded in the project tooling provenance. The exact old source bytes were unavailable in the current runtime, so this directory is not described as byte-identical. Behavioral audit compares strict same-class distance `<15`, descending score / ascending distance / stable order, centroid-based deletion, fixed-10 ROI averaging and pooled counts against an independent reference implementation derived from the official public Track-2 evaluator plus the historical master-report contract. Protected real evaluation additionally requires the configured evaluator hash/provenance gate.
